items.name: Roland
items.body:
Roland Buza founded RedLion Protection Group with the aim of delivering security services built on professionalism, accountability, and real-world experience.

With over a decade of operational experience, he has worked across close protection, residential security, safeguarding, and corporate environments — supporting high-profile, ultra-high-net-worth, and vulnerable individuals in the UK and internationally.

He remains closely involved in operations and training, ensuring that all services meet the standards expected within the security and close protection sector, with a focus on discretion, risk awareness, and professional conduct.

items.name: W. Hock
items.body:
W. Hock Hochheim serves as a consultant to RedLion Protection Group, contributing to training standards and operational methodology.

A former U.S. Army Military Police patrolman and investigator, retired Texas police officer and detective, and licensed private investigator, Hock spent over three decades in frontline roles — working directly in patrol, investigations, and real-world confrontations.

With over 50 years of experience in combatives, he has studied, tested, and taught hand, stick, knife, and firearm systems, holding multiple black belts across Filipino Martial Arts, Kajukenbo, Kenpo, and related disciplines. His work helped shape early concepts of integrated combatives, with a focus on practical application under pressure.

Hock has trained and consulted for U.S. military branches, law enforcement agencies, and tactical units internationally — including delivering instruction to Metropolitan Police personnel and Army units in the United Kingdom, as well as special operations units in Europe. His work has taken him across Europe, Asia, Africa, and Australia.

His international engagements have included work alongside internationally recognised figures such as Tom Clancy and Rudy Giuliani. Hock is a member of the Black Belt Magazine Hall of Fame and is widely recognised for his direct, experience-based approach to self-protection. Founder of *Force Necessary*, which later developed into *Survival Centric*, he continues to teach globally.

items.name: Slavisa
items.body:
At RedLion Protection Group, Slavisa Mendebaba brings over 20 years of military and professional security experience to the delivery of high-end protection services. A former Sergeant in the Serbian Armed Forces' 72nd Special Operations Brigade, he developed advanced skills in high-risk operations, threat assessment, and team leadership.

His career spans close protection for high-net-worth clients, leadership roles in maritime security within high-risk areas, and senior security management positions in London's luxury hospitality sector. This diverse background enables him to deliver structured, intelligence-led security solutions across a range of environments.

Slavisa is committed to maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, discretion, and operational excellence across all RedLion deployments.

items.name: John
items.body:
John Downie leads the Training Department at RedLion Protection Group, with responsibility for developing capable, disciplined, and cohesive close protection teams.

With a distinguished background in military leadership and training, including senior instructional roles within the British Army, John has extensive experience delivering structured, high-performance training programmes. He has led large-scale training operations, managing instructors and recruits through intensive development phases while maintaining the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and operational effectiveness.

His experience extends into close protection training, where he has instructed and mentored delegates across SIA-accredited programmes, focusing on practical skills, teamwork, and professional conduct. Recognised for his leadership and contribution to training excellence — including multiple commendations — he brings a disciplined and results-driven mindset to the development of RedLion's personnel.

items.name: Marek
items.body:
Marek David is the Founder and Managing Director of Premium International Protection Ltd, and serves as Sales & Marketing Lead Partner at RedLion Protection Group.

He is responsible for client engagement, business development, and strategic growth — supporting RedLion's positioning within high-end and security-sensitive environments. Through a strategic partnership with Premium International Protection Ltd, RedLion is able to access and engage with decision-makers across luxury hospitality, premium retail, and private client sectors.

Marek brings extensive experience in managing security and service delivery within luxury hospitality and high-end retail environments, where discretion, presentation, and client experience are critical. His role ensures that RedLion Protection Group's capabilities are represented professionally.
